leads.title: Penal Code, Section 377 ("Unnatural offences")
leads.documents: Criminalization of same-sex sexual activity in Bangladesh; punishment of life imprisonment or up to 10 years plus fine; applies to anal/oral sex regardless of gender/orientation, including consensual heterosexual fellatio/anal penetration.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Cited as inherited from British Indian Penal Code 1860 (effective 1862), carried into Pakistan Penal Code after 1947 partition, retained after 1971 independence; Parliament refused to overturn in 2009 and 2013. Full text quoted in article.

leads.title: Cabinet of Bangladesh decision, 11 November 2013, chaired by PM Sheikh Hasina
leads.documents: Official state recognition of hijras as separate/third gender alongside male/female on official documents; basis for voter-list third-gender option and hijra candidates.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Date and chair cited; notes 2014 codification; notes lack of policy on legal gender-change procedure and lack of anti-discrimination protections.

leads.title: Ministry of Social Welfare - survey (2013) and December 2014 employment invitation
leads.documents: Government count of 10,000 registered hijras in 2013; later invitation for hijras to apply for government employment; later housing scheme including transgender people (140 housed) and ~12,000 transgender individuals cited.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Cited as Ministry of Social Welfare survey and invitation; also cited for government-built houses project.

leads.title: Ministry of Health memorandum, January 2015
leads.documents: State procedure to identify hijras via thorough medical check-ups; documents forced strip/genital confirmation and release of photos claiming hijras are 'really men'.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Cited as memorandum requesting 'necessary steps are taken to identify hijras by conducting thorough medical check-ups'.

leads.title: U.S. Department of State Country Report on Human Rights Practices - Bangladesh, 2017 excerpt
leads.documents: Institutional human-rights report documenting: use of Section 377 as pretext to bully LGBTI and effeminate persons, limit LGBTI org registration, harassment under suspicious-behavior police provision; May raid by RAB on Chayaneer Community Center in Keraniganj Upazila during LGBTI dinner (120 present, 28 arrested, beatings, media photographing, narcotics yaba/cannabis charge, 4 remanded, 12 detained, 12 jailed); threats via phone/text/social media; weakened advocacy networks; employment and HIV stigma.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Long verbatim block quoted under 'United States Department of State report' heading covering extrajudicial killings, freedom of expression, LGBTI violence/discrimination, HIV stigma, employment discrimination.

leads.title: U.S. human rights report 2022 and Bangladesh government response
leads.documents: Documents continued U.S. finding of arbitrary arrests of LGBTQ persons and Bangladesh government rejection as regrettable imposition of values, claiming arrests go to court and are not arbitrary.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Cited as 2022 exchange in article text.

leads.title: Bangladesh Police charges, May 2019 - Murder of Xulhaz Mannan and Mahbub Rabbi Tonoy (April 2016)
leads.documents: Documented lethal anti-LGBTQ incident: killing of Roopbaan founder/publisher Xulhaz Mannan and activist Mahbub Rabbi Tonoy; claim by Ansar-al-Islam (Al-Qaeda-linked) citing shariah; 8 extremists charged, 4 in custody.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Cited under 'Murder of Xulhaz Mannan' with Roopbaan as only LGBTQ magazine context.

leads.title: National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Class VII History and Social Science textbook - 'Sharifar Golpo' / BRAC University incident 19-24 January 2024
leads.documents: State curriculum treatment of transgender/hijra identity (Sharif born male, identifies as woman Sharifa, lives as hijra); documents enforcement backlash: lecturer Asif Mahtab Utsha tearing pages at National Teachers Forum seminar, removal from lectures, BRAC student protests 'Say No To LGBTQ', Education Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury order for scrutiny/amendment.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Dates 19 Jan seminar, 21 Jan Facebook post, 24 Jan protest; seminar title 'New Textbook in Current Curriculum: Reality and Future'.

leads.title: Ministry of Education five-member review committee report (four months after Jan 2024)
leads.documents: Government rights-machinery decision on gender content: found nineteen words 'incompatible' with Bangladeshi society and recommended omission of story from textbook.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Cited as committee mostly consisting of Islamic scholars and educationists.

leads.title: World Values Survey 2017-2020 Bangladesh data; UNFPA Sixth Asian and Pacific Population Conference (16 Sept 2013) and International Conference on Population Development (Sept 2014)
leads.documents: Documents social/legal environment: 77.3% would not accept homosexual neighbour, 89.4% said homosexuality unjustifiable, 75.4% disagreed homosexual couples as good parents; plus state opposition to LGBTQ rights and sexuality education by Permanent Representative Abulkalam Abdul Momen stating it goes against social norms/values as Muslim country.
leads.detail: No URL visible. Also cites 2013 Gallup poll (28% said area not good for homosexuals, 19% said it was) and 2003 Dr. Gary Dowsett report 'A Review of Knowledge About the Sexual Networks and Behaviours of Men Who Have Sex with Men in Asia'.
